question: A 35-year-old man comes to the consultation referring to the appearance of a lump in the right inguinal region that does not produce any symptoms. A clinical examination suggests an inguinal hernia. All of the following statements are correct EXCEPT:

options.opa: An ultrasound should be done to confirm the diagnosis.
options.opb: The physical examination should be performed both in the supine position and in the standing position.
options.opc: It is highly probable that it is an indirect inguinal hernia.
options.opd: In the case of surgical treatment, the technique of choice would be a tension-free repair with a prosthetic mesh.
